jobs.description:

Har du skruet hænderne rigtigt på, og vil du være en del af et stærkt hold hos en af Danmarks største vognmænd?

Vi har rasende travlt og søger lige nu 2-3 dygtige trailermekanikere til vores moderne værksted i København. Uanset om du er i job i dag og trænger til luftforandring, eller om du er klar til at starte med det samme, hører vi meget gerne fra dig!

Hvem er vi?

Vi er en af landets førende vognmandsforretninger med en solid flåde på ca. 750 lastbiler og 1700 trailere. På værkstedet er tempoet højt, humøret godt, og du vil indgå i et stærkt team af dedikerede kollegaer, der løfter i flok for at holde vognparken kørende og trafiksikker.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver:

• 
Fejlfinding og reparation af jeres store trailerflåde.

• 
Planlagt vedligeholdelse og serviceeftersyn.

• 
Klargøring til syn og sikring af, at alt sikkerhedsudstyr er i top.

• 
Tæt samarbejde med dine kollegaer på værkstedet for at sikre et hurtigt og effektivt workflow.

Hvem er du?

• 
Erfaren: Du har konkret erfaring med reparation og vedligeholdelse af lastbiltrailere.

• 
Sprog: Du taler minimum engelsk (polsk er også en stor fordel, men ikke et krav).

• 
Mentalitet: Du er fleksibel, mødestabil og ikke bange for at tage fat, når der er travlt.

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

• 
Stærkt fællesskab: Masser af gode, dygtige og dedikerede kollegaer, der glæder sig til at tage imod dig.

• 
Ordnede forhold: Trygge rammer i en stor, stabil og professionelt drevet virksomhed.

• 
Attraktiv løn: God lønpakke, der matcher dine kvalifikationer.

• 
Hurtig opstart: Vi har brug for dig nu, så du kan starte med det samme.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Vi holder samtaler løbende, så tøv ikke med at række ud!

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join Biomason’s production facility in Ikast.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is motivated by solving real technical challenges, improving operational and equipment reliability, and helping scale a first-of-a-kind process toward commercial production.

Do you have solid experience from an industrial or manufacturing environment, and do you thrive in a setting where not everything has been fully built or established yet? Then we would very much like to hear from you.

 Read more about the role in the below job description.

If you have technical questions, you are welcome to contact Director of Plant Performance Aaron Bellis at +45 28966291 or HR Partner René Bitsch at +45 21756113.

If you are from a recruitment agency please note that we will contact you if we need your assistance.

Job description

The position:

As Mechanical engineer, you will play a hands-on role in establishing, stabilizing, and improving the mechanical performance of our first-of-a-kind tile production facility in Ikast. This role will work closely together with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, and Process Engineering to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient plant performance. You will help translate innovative process science into robust day-to-day manufacturing at the first of a kind facility, while driving structured problem-solving, equipment reliability, ppm, plant expansion support, and continuous improvement across the facility.

You will support the scaling of this process to our first commercial facility from engineering design and equipment selection through commissioning, start-up, and operations working together with our project department and our EPC firms.

Responsibilities also include:

• 
Mechanical Operations & Equipment Reliability

• 
Provide day-to-day supervisory and execution support for electrical and mechanical systems and production equipment across the tile manufacturing process.

• 
Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for mechanical failures, downtime events, and recurring equipment issues.

• 
Help establish preventive and predictive maintenance routines for critical equipment, utilities, and production assets.

• 
Support commissioning, start-up, and scale-up activities in a FOAK environment, helping to translate development work into reliable plant operation.

• 
Production Support & Continuous Improvement

• 
Partner with Operations and Quality teams to improve equipment performance, uptime, process stability, and product consistency.

• 
Contribute to waste reduction, line efficiency, and standardization efforts as production scales.

• 
  Technical leadership

• 
Support the development of SOPs, technical work instructions, equipment care standards, and troubleshooting guides.

• 
Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and internal teams on equipment modifications, installation work, and performance improvements.

• 
Project engineering and commercial facility scale-up

• 
With the Director of projects and an EPC firm, act as Biomason’s lead mechanical engineer supporting the development of FEL3 and detailed engineering design packages including participation in and review of Block Flow Diagrams (BFDs), Heat and Material Balances (HMBs), Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), General Arrangements (GAs), Basis of Design (BoD) documents, equipment specification and selection, and HAZOP (Hazard an Operations study).

• 
Support the commissioning and startup of the commercial facility through:

• 
Participation in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) at vendor sites as needed and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) at the facility.

• 
Provide on-site technical leadership during the "boots-on-the-ground" commissioning phase, troubleshooting mechanical, thermal, or other deviations in real-time.

• 
Bridge the gap between EPC firms and internal operations to ensure a seamless handover.

What we are looking for:

• 
Experience

• 
Minimum 5 years of experience in mechanical engineering, maintenance engineering, or a similar industrial role.

• 
Strong experience in industrial process or manufacturing environments, ideally with automated or semi-automated production equipment. Concrete manufacturing or other heavy industry is bonus but not essential.

• 
Experience with motors, heat exchangers, airflow and hydraulics is a strong advantage.

• 
Basic electrical experience testing logout tag out.

• 
Experience supporting production start-ups, greenfield projects, FOAK environments, or first-time industrial implementation is strongly preferred.

• 
Technical Expertise

• 
Experience working with crane and conveyance systems is a critical requirement of this position

• 
Strong understanding of industrial mechanical systems, equipment reliability, maintenance strategies, and structured troubleshooting.

• 
Experience with 5S, good manufacturing practices, and continuous improvement in a production setting.

• 
Ability to read technical drawings, manuals, equipment layouts, P&IDs, and supplier documentation.

• 
Familiarity with Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing principles, root cause analysis methodologies, and continuous improvement practices is an advantage.

• 
Management & Interpersonal Skills

• 
High attention to detail, with the ability to manage complex, detail-oriented projects and ensure disciplined follow-up through execution.

• 
Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to work across functions and cultures, preferable experience from a matrix organization..

• 
Structured, practical, and data-informed approach to problem-solving and decision-making.

• 
Contractor control

• 
Fluency in English is essential

On a personal level, the role needs the following approach:

• 
Proactive with a practical approach and the ability to be hands-on 

• 
Motivation to solve real industrial challenges

• 
Flexible where systems and routines are still being built

• 
A collaborative mindset, but also the ability to solve matters on your own

• 
Good safety attitude

• 
Can do attitude

jobs.occupation: Chief Commercial Officer
jobs.description:
About Memtrace

AI coding agents are fast, but they forget. They lose context between sessions, repeat mistakes, and don't understand the codebase around them. Memtrace builds the memory layer that fixes this: a deterministic knowledge graph of your code, built with AST parsing rather than guesswork, that any coding agent can use. Our products include MemDB, MemFleet, Cortex, and a code review engine. We are backed by Antler and Innovation Fund Denmark, and we work with Google, AWS, and Microsoft for Startups.

The role

You will own revenue end to end: strategy, pipeline, pricing, partnerships, and the first commercial team. We have developer interest and active pilots with enterprise customers. Your job is to turn that into repeatable, paying adoption. At this stage you will do the selling yourself while building the playbook that others will follow.

What you will do

• 
Define and run the go-to-market motion: developers adopt, engineering leaders and budget-holders buy.

• 
Own the revenue number and the pipeline. Run discovery, demos, pilots, and negotiations personally.

• 
Convert pilots into contracts, with clear success criteria, pricing, and procurement paths.

• 
Set pricing and packaging for individual, team, and enterprise tiers.

• 
Build channel and ecosystem partnerships (cloud marketplaces, consultancies, industry bodies, AI-coding-tool vendors).

• 
Feed customer and market insight back to product and research, and help decide what we build next.

• 
Hire and lead the first commercial team (sales, solutions, customer success) when the time is right.

• 
Report on pipeline, conversion, and retention to the founders and investors.

What we are looking for

• 
8+ years in B2B software sales or commercial leadership, with at least one role in developer tools, data/AI infrastructure, or open-source-led products.

• 
A track record of closing enterprise deals yourself, ideally in the Nordics or wider Europe.

• 
Experience selling to both technical champions and executive buyers, and knowing how those conversations differ.

• 
Comfort with ambiguity: you have built a sales motion without an existing playbook, brand, or team.

• 
Enough technical depth to talk credibly with engineers about codebases, CI/CD, and AI agents.

• 
Strong written and spoken English; Danish or another Nordic language is a plus.

Nice to have

• 
Experience with PLG, usage-based pricing, or open-core models.

• 
Existing relationships with engineering leaders at Nordic enterprises.

• 
Experience with EU procurement, security reviews, and data-residency requirements.

What we offer

• 
A founding-team seat with real ownership of the commercial side of the company.

• 
Direct influence on product, positioning, and company direction.

• 
Hybrid work in Copenhagen, with a small and fast-moving team.

Join NAKED Copenhagen as our new Creative Lead

Do you see visuals before they exist? Do you know how to turn brand identity into campaigns, designs, content, and experiences that people remember?

Then you might be the Creative Lead we’re looking for at NAKED Copenhagen.

This is not just a design role. It’s a key creative position at the heart of our Marketing & Creative Team, someone who’s shaping how NAKED Copenhagen looks, feels, and communicates across every touchpoint.

About the Role

As our new Creative Lead, you’ll take ownership of our visual direction and help bring our brand universe to life across digital, physical, and social platforms.

Working closely with Stine, our Founder & CEO, you’ll play a key role in translating NAKED Copenhagen’s vision into creative concepts, campaigns, and experiences that resonate with our colleagues, partners, community, and customers.

You’ll collaborate closely with various professionals in the Marketing & Creative Team, as well as E-Commerce, Retail, Buying & Merchandising, and external partners, to develop ideas and execute content that strengthens our brand presence.

From campaign editorials and website experiences to social media, collaborations, and product design, you’ll be a central part of shaping, maintaining, and evolving the NAKED Copenhagen identity.

What You’ll Do

•          Owning and evolving the brand's creative direction and visual identity across all customer touchpoints.

•          Developing creative concepts and leading the visual execution of campaigns, content and brand experiences.

•          Design and deliver exciting, engaging graphics across web pages, newsletters, logos, signs, advertisements, instore window layouts and other communication materials.

•          Leading art direction for photo, video and content productions while ensuring a consistently high creative standard.

•          Overseeing the visual expression across digital platforms, retail, events and all brand communication.

•          Collaborating closely with Marketing, Ecommerce and other key teams to translate business objectives into compelling creative solutions.

•          Leading selected collaborations, special projects and brand activations that strengthen the brand's visual identity and positioning.

 

Who You Are

•          A confident creative thinker with a strong eye for aesthetics, detail, and visual storytelling.

•          5+ years of experience within the fashion and lifestyle industry, with a scope including execution on design processes, graphic design, and campaign development.

•          Experience with developing visual concepts from idea to final execution.

•          Passionate about fashion, sneakers, culture, and contemporary brand building.

•          Comfortable balancing creativity with ambitious commercial goals and deadlines.

•          Able to work independently while collaborating closely with different teams while translating the creative agenda and vision.

•          Structured, proactive, and able to manage multiple projects at once as we always operate with an ambitious marketing calendar.

•          Strong understanding of digital platforms, social media trends, and content creation.

•          Communicate confidently in English, written and spoken.

•          Have experience from a similar creative, design, or brand-focused role.

About the Marketing & Creative Team

You’ll join our Marketing & Creative Team led by Simon, our Buying & Marketing Director. Together, the team shapes and executes everything from campaigns and launches to shoots, social content, events, and brand collaborations.

What We Offer

•          A fast-moving and creative work environment.

•          A role where your ideas directly shape the NAKED Copenhagen brand.

•          Creative ownership and responsibility from day one.

•          Close collaboration with a passionate team across marketing, e-commerce, retail, and buying.

•          Hands-on involvement in campaigns, launches, collaborations, and brand experiences.

•          A workplace where creativity, energy, and teamwork matter.

•          A job that goes beyond the desk.

Interested?

Please send your CV and application in English or Danish to job@nakedcph.com with “Creative Lead” in the subject line.

We’re looking forward to meeting you.

On behalf of,
Simon, Marketing & Creative Department
& the rest of the NAKED Copenhagen Team

jobs.occupation: Front of house server needed for Martini House Restaurant
jobs.description:
English Version Below

Fuldtid eller deltid · Opstart efter aftale

Martini House er en italiensk-amerikansk nabolagsrestaurant på Brigadevej i Amager. Vi laver den slags mad, vi selv elsker at spise — generøs, klassisk og ukompliceret — i et rum, der er varmt, livligt og en lille smule old-school.

Vi leder efter flere tjenere til vores lille team.

For os handler god service først og fremmest om værtskab. Vi vil have gæsterne til at føle sig velkomne, godt taget hånd om og have lyst til at komme igen. Det betyder, at vi tager vores arbejde seriøst, men ikke os selv alt for seriøst.

Vi leder efter mennesker med personlighed, som kan læse et bord, arbejde hurtigt, når restauranten er fuld, og stadig få gæsterne til at føle, at de har god tid.

Dine opgaver

• Tage varmt og naturligt imod vores gæster og sørge for, at de føler sig hjemme

• Guide gæsterne gennem menuen og vores vin- og cocktailkort med selvtillid og personlighed

• Have ansvar for din sektion og holde styr på tempo, timing og detaljer gennem hele service

• Arbejde tæt sammen med køkken, bar og resten af FOH-teamet

• Være opmærksom på hele restauranten — ikke kun dine egne borde

• Hjælpe dine kolleger, når de har travlt, og bidrage til en stærk og generøs servicekultur

• Holde restauranten ren, organiseret og klar til gæster

• Være til stede og engageret på gulvet fra første til sidste bord

Vi leder efter dig, der

• Har erfaring fra restaurant eller hospitality — gerne fra en travl restaurant

• Oprigtigt kan lide at tage sig af mennesker

• Har personlighed og selvtillid uden at gøre service formel eller stiv

• Kan holde hovedet koldt, når restauranten er fuld

• Ser, hvad der skal gøres, uden altid at skulle blive bedt om det

• Er nysgerrig på mad, vin og cocktails

• Er stabil, professionel og en god kollega

• Taler dansk eller engelsk — dansk er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Vi tilbyder

• En arbejdsplads, hvor gode idéer bliver hørt, og hvor du kan få mere ansvar, hvis du ønsker det

• Mulighed for at lære mere om mad, vin, cocktails og hospitality

• Et sted, hvor vi arbejder hårdt, har det sjovt og gerne vil være rigtig gode til det, vi laver

Hvis Martini House lyder som et sted for dig, så send dit CV og et par linjer om dig selv til work@martinihouse.dk

Full-time or Part-time · Start Date: By Agreement

Martini House is an Italian-American neighborhood restaurant on Brigadevej in Amager. We serve the kind of food we love to eat — generous, classic and uncomplicated — in a room that’s warm, lively and a little bit old-school.

We’re looking for more servers to join our small team.

For us, great service starts with hospitality. We want people to feel genuinely welcome, well taken care of, and excited to come back. That means taking the job seriously without taking ourselves too seriously.

We’re looking for people with personality who can read a table, move quickly when the restaurant is full, and still make guests feel like there’s nowhere they need to be.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc positions within Robotics for Laboratory Automation
jobs.description:
SDU Robotics is currently extending the team within the project CAPeX which focuses on robotics for laboratory automation. We therefore invite applications for one or more fully funded postdoc positions. The position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

 

What we offer

• 
An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

• 
A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

• 
Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

• 
Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

• 
An opportunity to collaborate with excellent researchers within the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery

 

Job description

SDU Robotics currently has an open 2-year postdoc position in relation to CAPeX; specifically, for the development of a robotic solution for automation of laboratory experiments that require manipulation of tubes, fragile glass vials, and liquids. The robotic solution should be flexible in the sense that it should be able to conduct several experiments with little user-intervention, operate alongside humans, and recover from failures. Consequently, visual feedback must be used for adapting robot behavior to a dynamic environment.  The postdoc should contribute to the deployment of the developed solution in laboratories in both SDU and DTU. The successful candidate will work closely with other PhDs and postdoc candidates in CAPeX.

As a postdoctoral researcher, your role will encompass mainly research, but teaching responsibilities could also be part of the employment. The main duties and responsibilities include: 

• 
Research in collaboration with colleagues from SDU Robotics and CAPeX.

• 
Conducting scientific research and publishing the results in high quality scientific conferences/journals.

• 
Supporting the team in securing external funding.

• 
Contributing to the project CAPeX deliverables. 

 

Profile and requirements

The position requires research experience at PhD level in a relevant area such as robotics, preferably applied to robotic systems controlled using visual feedback. The candidate is hence expected to have most of the following qualifications:

• 
Expert knowledge in the control of robots

• 
Experience in simulation of robotic systems

• 
Experience in design and development of robotic systems

• 
Experience with using computer vision.

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to:

• 
Have excellent knowledge of English (written and spoken).

• 
Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team.

• 
Have the ability of working independently.

• 
Have a strong sense of responsibility.

• 
Conduct independent research. 

 

Research environment

The candidate will be integrated into the SDU Robotics unit, which is a team of approx. 60 employees. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics. The group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners.

We are a team specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, estimation, and control of advanced robot systems. In addition, the candidate will be integrated into CAPeX - a pioneer center for accelerating P2X materials discovery and working on automation of laboratory experiments.

CAPeX is a 13-year and 300 MDKK “Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery”, funded by Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science, the Danish National Research Foundation, the Carlsberg Foundation, the Lundbeck Foundation, the Novo Nordisk Foundation, and the Villum Foundation. CAPeX is hosted by the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) and co-hosted by Aalborg University (AAU), and unites leading experts from DTU, AAU, University of Copenhagen, Aarhus University, and the University of Southern Denmark with international partners from Stanford University, Utrecht University, and the University of Toronto to form a truly Pioneering Center on P2X. You can read more about the CAPeX research themes and X-trails, our organization, and the other open PhD and postdoc cohort positions at http://www.capex-p2x.com. 

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your academic growth as a researcher in SDU Robotics. 

 

Further information 

Further information about this position is available via email from Professor Christoffer Sloth chsl@mmmi.sdu.dk.

Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

The application deadline is October 28, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

• 
A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

• 
Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information. 

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

• 
List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications.

The application may also include: 

• 
Research statement. 

• 
Summary of experience in teaching. 

• 
References (names and emails) and/or reference letters.

• 
Documentation of other qualifications with relevance for the position. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2026. Extension may be possible depending on available funding (no more than 4 years at the same university).

The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

Research will be predominant in the position. Teaching assignments can be agreed individually. Furthermore, other types of assignments may occur to a limited degree. The faculty determines the distribution of the various assignments. The weighting of the different assignments may vary over time.

Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

jobs.occupation: Associate professor of Equine Sports Medicine
jobs.description:
Associate professor of Equine Sports Medicine

  Department of Veterinary Clinical Sciences

  Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences

  University of Copenhagen

   

  The University seeks to appoint an associate professor within Equine Sports Medicine to the Department of Veterinary Clinical Sciences to commence 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  Information on the Department can be found at: http://www.sund.ku.dk/ and www.ikv.ku.dk/english.

  About us

  The Department of Veterinary Clinical Sciences covers strong and internationally recognized research areas in clinical veterinary sciences. A relatively large part of our research is fertilised and inspired from clinical challenges, identified in the hospital, in our ambulatory field practice or from our external collaborators. Based on these, we want to set a new standard for cross-disciplinary research, education and innovation within animal health and disease.

  The Section for Medicine, Surgery and Reproduction for Large animals holds research and clinical teaching, in a modern 24-hour open university veterinary teaching hospital and ambulatory field practice service for all large animals with horses as the primary species consulted. We also have the cross departmental, University of Copenhagen Centre for Veterinary Simulation, which is open 24/7 for veterinary students to practice clinical skills. Our research is focused on diseases of clinical relevance for horses and cattle thereby having a direct application for veterinarians and animal owners. Also, translational research bridging basic science to companion animal as well as human medicine is a strength of the section.

  We have a strong educational and scientific focus on the athletic horse collaborating with internationally recognised research groups within cardiovascular, airway and orthopaedic research with a high impact translational research profile. To fully exploit the scientific and clinical potentials, the muscular development and disease understanding in sports and rehabilitation medicine both in horses and companion animals and is a strategic research area in the department, why collaboration with the companion animal sections of the department is expected in the position. The announced associate professorship is crucial to enhancing and strengthening this area to fully obtain the synergy of the other research areas mentioned above.

  Equine medicine is a core discipline in the fourth and fifth years of the veterinary medical education in Denmark. Therefore the position is highly involved in research based teaching of veterinary students within equine sports medicine  and the candidate is expected to take a leadership role in conducting clinical relevant research, teaching and examining undergraduate students, as well as assist and promote the development of both pre-and postgraduate teaching as well as research strategies within the field of equine sports medicine.  

  The culture of the department is typical Scandinavian: a flat structure with a tradition for close collaboration where all employees are expecting openness, mutual respect, and sharing of ideas, resources and competences.

  Job description

  In considering applications for the associate professorship, the main emphasis will be on the following aspects:

   	
• The applicant's ability to document a high level of original scientific production at an international level within the area of equine sports medicine and preferably with a strong translational profile. 	
• The applicant’s practical experience within equine general medicine in both a hospital and in research setting. 	
• The applicants experience with development of clinical research-based teaching of veterinary students.   The associate professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of:

   	
• Research, including publication/academic dissemination 	
• Research-based pre-and postgraduate teaching, including clinical teaching and service, associated examination and course responsibilities 	
• Strengthen, developing and integrating muscular research in research-based teaching of veterinary students 	
• Research leadership, including guidance and supervision of researchers and veterinary students as well as securing external funding. 	
• Obligation to share knowledge with the rest of society, including participation in public debate and engagement in topics of relevance for horse owners 	
• Organizational contribution to the section, department and university incl. e.g. participation in department committees and course leadership. 	
• Academic assessments   Required qualifications

  To be qualified for an associate professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution and leadership.

  Find information about each criterion.

  The successful applicant should:

   	
• Hold a DVM with license to practice in Denmark or be willing to apply for such within 6 months. 	
• Hold a PhD degree or similar qualifications. 	
• Diplomat degree within ECEIM, ACVIM or ECVSMR is an advantage. 	
• Document a high degree of research experience and scientific publications within the field of equine internal medicine and sports medicine at an international level, including considerable contributions to the development of the academic discipline. 	
• Have experience with research management and other management functions, including attraction of external funding and group leadership. 	
• Document pre-and postgraduate clinical teaching experience within the field of the position and documented pedagogical training at university level. 	
• Perform research-based teaching. 	
• Perform quality patient care and service management in an equine hospital and ambulatory field practice within equine general medicine. 	
• Possess good interpersonal and communicative skills. 	
• If Danish is not the first language, the applicant is expected to obtain sufficient Danish skills within 1-2 years.   Diversity and International Applicants

  The University of Copenhagen is committed to fostering diversity and encourages all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of personal background.

  Useful resources:

   	
• www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility) 	
• www.workingconditions.ku.dk.   Terms of employment

  The position is a permanent position.

  The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

  Employment is as associate professor according to the collective agreement or job structure under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025.

  This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package for up to 2,500,000 DKK that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. Please read about the contents of the programme and conditions, as well as UCPH’s extensive support for international researchers here

  Questions

  For further information, please contact group leader Tina Holberg Pihl thpi@sund.ku.dk.

  Application

  The application must be submitted in English, by clicking on "Apply online" below, and must include the following:

   	
• Application, including motivation for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages) 	
• Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding) 	
• A complete list of publications 	
• Diplomas - (Master’s, PhD, and other relevant certificates) 	
• Upload a list of maximum 5 publications to be assessed 	
• Research plan (3-5 pages) 	
• Teaching plan 	
• Teaching portfolio (Guidelines)   The further process 
 After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee.  All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The Dean then appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee and each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at the university's job portal.

  Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

  Please submit the application with the required attachments.

  The closing date for applications is 29 October 2026 23.59 p.m. CET.

  Employer: Department of Veterinary Clinical and Animal Sciences, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. Homepage: http://ikvh.ku.dk/english/

  The University of Copenhagen actively influences current and future generations through excellent research, education and co-operation. UCPH is one of the highest ranked universities in Europe and is Denmark´s oldest university, founded in 1479. Today, the University has 37,000 students and

  9,000 employees affiliated across six faculties: humanities, law, natural sciences, social sciences, health sciences and theology www.ku.dk/english.

jobs.occupation: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobs.description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

·         Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
·         Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
·         General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.
 
We expect you to

·         Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
·         Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
·         Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
·         Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
·         Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
·         Not be afraid of getting dirty
·         Understand and speak English

Please note:
You must be an EU/EEA citizen. Applicants who do not meet this requirement should not apply.

Terms of employment

jobs.occupation: Baker - Bakery Production - Maribo, Lolland, Denmark
jobs.description:
Den Gamle Bagergaard in Maribo is looking for a baker. You do not need a formal qualification if you have practical experience working in a bakery.

We are a family-run business with three bakers and a pastry chef in production. Two packing staff and a driver help get our bread ready and delivered to our shops.

Your work

You will take part in the daily production at the bakery. We are looking for someone who knows their way around a bakery, takes responsibility for their work and enjoys working with colleagues. You must be able to communicate in Danish or understandable English.

You must already have the legal right to work in Denmark, for example through EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship or a valid Danish residence and work permit. We cannot offer visa or work permit sponsorship.

What we offer

Gross monthly salary: Based on qualifications and experience. For a qualified baker, the salary starts at approximately DKK 26,000.

Permanent, full-time employment

Pension scheme

5 weeks of vacation

Flexible benefits account

Additional pay for applicable night and Sunday work

The employer can support you in finding accommodation in the area

The planned working hours start at 01:30 on Mondays and 05:00 from Tuesday to Thursday. You will also work every other weekend. During the night shifts on Mondays and every other weekend, you will bake bread, Danish pastries and other baked goods. We will agree on the schedule together, and working night shifts only is also an option.

The expected start date is 1 November 2026.

Recruitment process

The first interview can be held online if needed. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the bakery before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications as they arrive, so please apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your application and CV to rekruttering@lolland.dk with "Baker - Maribo" in the subject line.

If you have questions, contact Martin Hansen, Business Consultant and EURES Adviser at Lolland Municipality, on +45 21 47 73 43 or maha@lolland.dk.

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and relocation support

Lolland is in southern Denmark and offers easy access to nature, beaches and open countryside, along with affordable housing and short commuting distances. The region is developing rapidly, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link between Denmark and Germany.

If you are moving from abroad, Lolland Municipality's Newcomers Service can help with practical questions about relocation, registration, housing, a partner's job search and settling in Denmark. Read more at https://newcomers.lolland.dk/. You can also find information about working in Denmark at https://www.workindenmark.dk/
